groups.name: Stop rescanning every ledger line when a round judges annotations
groups.rationale: Adds filtering to the ledger store so session annotation lookups read only their own kind, repo and round ids instead of parsing the entire ledger, reducing 185ms to 22ms on a 50k-record ledger.
groups.watch: The substring gate must not reject lines that match — false negatives break the query; the month file filter compares only the YYYY-MM prefix so a since timestamp halfway through a month does not skip that month entirely.

groups.name: Documentation and backlog closure
groups.rationale: Marks the stated intent complete and documents the performance fix and its constraints.
groups.watch: The entry correctly names the cost, the new field names, and the trade-off that corrupt counts a filtered read, not the whole ledger.

groups.name: Planning artifacts for related future work
groups.rationale: Adds design documents exploring approval carrying across rounds, front-end draft preservation, focus state modeling, and two-round validation — context for understanding the ledger changes but not implementing them.
groups.watch: These are planning documents only; none of their proposed changes are in the code being reviewed.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
